senses.definition: a language that a person has acquired in adolescence or later
examples: Research on adult-learned second language (L2) has provided considerable insight into the neurocognitive mechanisms underlying the learning and processing of L2 grammar
A period of limited exposure generally leads to attrition (loss) of L2 performance or knowledge
Crucially, it is also desirable to retain them, even in the absence of continued practice or exposure to the L2
